items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 as an insured electrical appliance physically damaged by overvoltage; subject to the appliance sub-limit and 7.1.9 (no betterment). Reference Cases 1, 15, 17 show t between 253 and 537 for similar items, with no surge protection so indemnity is halved per 2.3.3.

items.description: Premium replacement TV set (larger, higher-end than the damaged one)
items.rationale: Only the cost of a standard 55-inch mainstream-brand LED TV (pre-loss standard) is indemnified per 7.1.9; higher-end upgrade is not covered. Reference Cases 1, 9, 15, 17 show t between 517 and 616 for similar TVs, halved for lack of surge protection.

Accessories only indemnified if physically damaged by the insured event (2.3.3, 4.2.4); reference cases 9, 15, 17 show t below 17, possibly 0, for such items. Usually excluded as not proven damaged or as improvement.
Not indemnified unless physical damage from the surge is proven (2.3.3, 4.2.4, 7.1.5); reference cases 9, 15, 17 show t below 14, possibly 0.
Only indemnified if physically damaged by the surge (2.3.3, 4.2.4); reference cases 9, 17 show t below 17, possibly 0. Usually excluded unless clear evidence of damage.

items.description: Games console (switched off and unplugged at the time)
items.rationale: Not covered: not physically damaged by the insured event (2.3.3, 4.2.4, 7.1.5); description confirms it was unplugged and unaffected.
Explicitly excluded as an ancillary charge for bringing replacement property to the site (7.1.8(b)); reference cases 9, 15, 17 show t below 12, possibly 0.
Explicitly excluded as an ancillary charge for fitting/commissioning replacement property (7.1.8(c)); reference cases 9, 15, 17 show t below 37, possibly 0.

items.description: Diagnostic inspection and surge-failure report for damaged electronics
items.rationale: Not indemnified: outlay for inspection/reporting is excluded (3.1.5, 7.1.8(e), 7.1.8(f)); reference cases 9, 15, 17 show t below 56, possibly 0.

items.description: Wiring safety check of property distribution board
items.rationale: Not indemnified: safety check is not a repair cost for physical damage (3.1.5, 7.1.8(e)); reference cases 9, 17 show t below 33, possibly 0.

Ancillary charge only indemnified if on same invoice as covered work (7.1.8(d)); as all other lines on this invoice are excluded, this is also excluded. Reference cases 9, 15, 17 show t below 14, possibly 0.
